title: Metti lo diavolo tuo ne lo mio inferno
writer: Bitto Albertini, Marino Onorati, Vittorio Vighi
actors: Antonio Cantafora, Melinda Pillon, Margaret Rose Keil
plot: Riccardo is a charismatic small town's playboy who encourages all his friends to have an affair with all the married and maiden women in town, including the wife of the mayor. Lots of debauchery ensues.
